zh: 下过雨之后江风一下就凉了，早知道多带条围巾。
en: After the rain the wind off the river turns cold so fast. Should've brought a scarf.

zh: 十一月就这样，白天看着还暖和，一过五点天就暗下来了。
en: That's November. Looks warm in the daytime, then after five it's dark.

zh: 我刚从南京东路走过来，地铁口那家糖炒栗子已经排起长队了。
en: I walked over from Nanjing Road just now. The chestnut place by the metro already has a queue.

zh: 那家做了很多年了，这个点买一袋揣兜里，刚好暖暖手。
en: They've been there for years. Get a bag at this hour, keep it in your pocket, warms your hands.

zh: 今晚打算回家自己做饭，还是在附近随便吃点？
en: Cooking at home tonight, or just grabbing something round here?

zh: 加班到这个点就不折腾了，去巷口吃碗葱油拌面，再加个煎蛋。
en: Working this late, I'm not making a fuss. Scallion-oil noodles at the corner, with a fried egg.

zh: 天冷喝碗热汤更舒服，小馄饨配两只生煎也不错。
en: When it's cold, hot soup's better. Little wontons and a couple of shengjian aren't bad either.

zh: 别说了，越说越饿，再吹会儿风我就去买单。
en: Stop it, the more you talk the hungrier I get. Five more minutes of wind and I'm going.

zh: 对岸东方明珠刚才亮灯那一下，江面上全倒映出来了。
en: The Pearl Tower lights came on just now. The whole river lit up with it.

zh: 我每天晚饭后都要沿外滩走这一段，透透气，比闷在屋里强。
en: I walk this stretch of the Bund every day after dinner. Fresh air beats sitting indoors.

zh: 待会儿你是坐公交回去，还是顺着江边一路走到渡口那边？
en: How are you getting back? Bus, or walking along the river all the way to the ferry?

zh: 看时间吧，慢慢走过去，权当活动一下腿脚。
en: Depends on the time. I'll take it slow, call it stretching my legs.

zh: 晚上好。刚下过雨，栏杆边风挺凉的，小心别着凉。
en: Evening. It's just rained, the wind's cold by the railing. Don't catch a chill.

zh: 还在外滩逛呢？这会儿对岸的灯开得正好看。
en: Still wandering the Bund? The lights across the river are at their best right now.

zh: 不急的话多吹吹风吧，夜里的江边比白天清净些。
en: If you're not in a hurry, enjoy the breeze a bit. The river's quieter at night than in the day.

zh: 你也在打听老周？二十九号傍晚他收了摊，就再没人见过他。他家里人托我取一样东西，我腿脚不方便，你能帮我跑一趟吗？
en: You're asking about Old Zhou too? He packed up his stall at dusk on the twenty-ninth and nobody's seen him since. His family asked me to collect something. My legs aren't what they were. Could you go for me?

zh: 汉口路往西，老周的修表摊，柜台上有个封好的文件袋。原样拿回来给我，别拆。
en: West along Hankou Road, Old Zhou's watch stall. There's a sealed document pouch on the counter. Bring it back as it is. Don't open it.

zh: 就在汉口路北边，修表摊的柜台上。封好的那个。
en: North side of Hankou Road, on the counter of the watch stall. The sealed one.

zh: 封得好好的，辛苦你了。他家里人会放心的。
en: Sealed, just as it should be. Thank you. His family will be relieved.

zh: 封条破了。……你看过了。那上面的日子，别跟别人提。
en: The seal's broken. ...You've read it. The date on that page, don't mention it to anyone.

zh: 又碰到你了。上回那件事办妥了，多谢。
en: We meet again. That business went fine. Thank you.

zh: 还在这儿？江边风大，早点回去吧。
en: Still here? The wind's strong by the river. Get home early.

zh: 这条路啊，十一月一到，晚上全是来拍照的。外滩嘛，拍不厌的。
en: This road... come November it's all people taking photos at night. The Bund, they never get tired of it.

zh: 你看前面这个，打着双闪停在那里——哎，侬停啥停啦。……不好意思啊，职业病。
en: Look at this one up ahead, hazards on, just parked there. Hey, what are you stopping for? ...Sorry. Occupational hazard.

zh: 以前出租车好开，现在人人手机一点，车子嘛，多得来……
en: Taxis used to be easy. Now everyone taps their phone and there are cars everywhere...

zh: 生煎现在一客要二十几块了你晓得伐？我小时候……算了，说出来像老头子。
en: You know shengjian are over twenty kuai a serving now? When I was a kid... forget it, I sound like an old man.

zh: 油价我是不管了，电车嘛，充一次电三四十块，比以前省多了。就是充电桩要抢。
en: Petrol prices aren't my problem any more. Electric, thirty, forty kuai a charge, much cheaper. You just have to fight for a charger.

zh: 今朝冷了嘛，江边风大。你穿得少了，小伙子。
en: Cold today, eh. Windy by the river. You're not wearing enough, young man.

zh: 天气预报讲明天要落雨，我看不一定，上海的天，跟小姑娘的脾气一样。……这句话现在不能讲了是伐？
en: Forecast says rain tomorrow. I wouldn't count on it. Shanghai weather's like a young girl's moods. ...Can't say that any more, can you?

zh: 和平饭店晓得伐？老底子叫华懋饭店。我们那时候开出租，晚上停门口等客人，一等一个钟头。
en: You know the Peace Hotel? Used to be the Cathay. Back when I drove a taxi we'd wait outside for fares at night. An hour at a time.

zh: 这边好多老房子都在修，修得交关漂亮，就是里面住啥人，我们就不晓得了。
en: Lots of the old buildings round here are being done up. Beautifully, too. Who lives in them, though, people like us wouldn't know.

zh: 我女儿在美国读书，学什么……数据分析。我问她分析啥，她说讲了你也不懂。……那倒是。
en: My daughter's studying in America. Data... analysis. I asked her analysing what, she said I wouldn't understand. ...Fair enough.

zh: 哎哎哎——侬会不会开车啦！
en: Hey hey hey! Can you even drive?!

zh: 戆大！转弯灯不会打的啊？
en: Idiot! Never heard of an indicator?

zh: ……侬眼睛瞎脱啦？！
en: ...Are you blind?!

zh: 喂喂喂！红灯呀！侬命不要了啊！
en: Oi oi oi! It's red! Do you want to die?!

zh: 这种人……撞上去算谁的？算我的！
en: People like that... and if I hit him, whose fault is it? Mine!

zh: 哎哟——吓煞我了。
en: Aiyo, scared the life out of me.

zh: 我白天卖软件，晚上开车。……不是缺钱啊，是——好吧，也缺。
en: I sell software in the day and drive at night. ...Not that I need the money, it's... OK, I need the money.

zh: 现在做生意，你得有个“故事”。投资人听故事的。我的故事就是，我还在开滴滴。哈哈。
en: Business now, you need a 'story'. Investors buy stories. My story is I'm still driving for DiDi. Ha.

zh: 陆家嘴那帮人啊，我拉过好多，一上车就开会，耳机一戴，“对齐一下颗粒度”……我都会背了。
en: The Lujiazui crowd, I've driven loads of them. Get in, earbuds in, straight onto a call: 'let's align on the granularity'... I know it by heart.

zh: 导航让我走这条，我不信它，但我还是走了。人跟导航，就是这种关系。
en: The sat-nav said go this way. I don't trust it, but I went anyway. That's people and sat-navs for you.

zh: 昨天那场你看了吗？申花……算了，不说了，说了心痛。
en: Did you see the game yesterday? Shenhua... never mind. Too painful.

zh: 合肥这时候比上海冷多了。上海这种冷是往骨头里钻的，你懂吧，湿冷。
en: Hefei's much colder than this right now. But Shanghai cold gets in your bones, you know? Damp cold.

zh: 兄弟，这不是赛道啊！
en: Mate, this isn't a racetrack!

zh: 我靠……你这变道比我老板变脸还快。
en: Jeez... you change lanes faster than my boss changes his mind.

zh: 行行行，你先，你先。
en: Fine, fine, you first, you first.

zh: 哎——看车啊！
en: Hey! Watch for cars!

zh: 你看看，低头看手机，路都不看……
en: Look at that, head down in his phone, not even looking...

zh: 我刹得住，下一个司机未必。
en: I could stop. The next driver might not.

zh: 我儿子明年中考……成绩还行，就是爱打游戏。你们年轻人小时候也这样吧？
en: My son takes his high-school exams next year... His grades are OK, he just loves his games. You young people were all like that, weren't you?

zh: 老家的人都觉得我在上海挺好的。挺好的，就是累。
en: People back home think I'm doing well in Shanghai. I am. It's just tiring.

zh: ……这个点堵，没办法。你急吗？急的话我走中山东二路。
en: ...Traffic's bad this time of day, nothing to be done. Are you in a hurry? If you are, I'll take Zhongshan East 2nd Road.

zh: 今天还好，没下雨。下雨天单子多，但是路滑，心里不踏实。
en: Today's all right, no rain. More fares when it rains, but the roads are slippery. I don't feel easy.

zh: 哎呀……我的天爷。
en: Oh... good heavens.

zh: ……你急你先走嘛。
en: ...If you're in such a hurry, go on then.

zh: 哎呀妈呀——吓死我了。
en: Oh my god, that scared me half to death.

zh: （深呼吸）……没事，没事。
en: (Deep breath) ...It's fine. It's fine.

zh: 你看看，这电动车，红灯它也冲。……我不是说你啊。
en: Look at that, the e-bike's running the red. ...Not talking about you.

zh: 外滩这一块，不让停车，接人都得到路口那个点。你下回叫车，就定在汉口路口，别定在楼门口，司机找不着。
en: Round the Bund you can't stop, pickups have to be at the corner. Next time you call a car, set it at the Hankou Road corner, not outside the building. Drivers can't find you.

zh: 我以前给中介开车，拉看房的。那些人啊，看一套两千万的房子，跟买白菜一样。
en: I used to drive for an estate agency, taking people to viewings. Those people look at a twenty-million flat like they're buying cabbage.

zh: 现在房子不好卖，可是好房子还是好卖。你懂我意思吧？好东西永远不愁。
en: Flats are hard to sell now, but good ones still sell. Know what I mean? Good things always find a buyer.

zh: 静安那边有个大平层，挂了半年没卖掉，听说房东是个……算了算了，我嘴碎。
en: There's a big flat over in Jing'an, on the market six months, not sold. They say the owner's a... forget it, forget it, I talk too much.

zh: 嘿！你这人怎么开车的！
en: Hey! What kind of driving is that!

zh: 找死呢你！别让我追上你！
en: You got a death wish? Don't let me catch you!

zh: ……驾照买的吧？
en: ...Bought your licence, did you?

zh: 往哪儿走呢！红灯！
en: Where d'you think you're going! It's red!

zh: 你家人知道你这么过马路吗？！
en: Does your family know you cross roads like that?!

zh: 我真服了……
en: Unbelievable...

zh: 嗯，冷了。
en: Mm. Getting cold.

zh: 快了。前面右转就到。
en: Nearly there. Right turn ahead.

zh: ……以前我开饭店的。现在开车。都一样，赚辛苦钱。
en: ...I used to run a restaurant. Now I drive. Same thing. Hard money either way.

zh: （按了一下喇叭）
en: (A tap on the horn)
...Tsk.

zh: （猛按喇叭）
en: (Leans on the horn)

zh: ……作死。
en: ...Asking for it.

zh: 不好意思。
en: Sorry.

zh: 抱歉抱歉。
en: Sorry, sorry.

zh: 哎，不好意思啊。
en: Oh, sorry about that.

zh: 没事没事。
en: It's fine, it's fine.

zh: 没关系。
en: No problem.

zh: 看着点路。
en: Watch where you're going.

zh: 哎——走路看着点啊。
en: Hey, look where you're walking.

zh: 你有完没完？
en: Are you done yet?

zh: 怎么又是你？
en: You again?

zh: 啊，sorry sorry。
en: Ah, sorry sorry.

zh: 不好意思哈。
en: Sorry!

zh: 没事。
en: No worries.

zh: 没事儿，没事儿。
en: All good, all good.

zh: 兄弟，看路啊。
en: Mate, eyes on the road.

zh: 急什么啊。
en: What's the rush?

zh: 又来？故意的吧。
en: Again? That's on purpose.

zh: 你有毛病啊。
en: What's wrong with you?

zh: 哦——抱歉！
en: Oh — sorry!

zh: 抱歉，借过。
en: Sorry, excuse me.

zh: 嘿——小心点。
en: Hey — watch it.

zh: 你认真的吗？
en: Seriously?

zh: 哦，对不起。
en: Oh, I'm sorry.

zh: 哎，对不住啊。
en: Ah, my apologies.

zh: 不要紧，不要紧。
en: Never mind, never mind.

zh: 年轻人，慢点走。
en: Slow down, young man.

zh: 走路不看路的啊？
en: Don't you look where you walk?

zh: 你这个人怎么回事？
en: What's the matter with you?

zh: 哦，对不住。
en: Oh, my fault.

zh: 哎哟，慢点慢点，没事。
en: Whoa, easy, easy. No harm done.

zh: 小心点，我这把老骨头经不起撞。
en: Careful. These old bones can't take a knock.

zh: 你今天怎么毛毛躁躁的？
en: Why are you so jumpy today?

zh: 啊，不好意思。
en: Ah, sorry.

zh: 诶——当心点。
en: Hey, careful.

zh: ……你是故意的吧？
en: ...You're doing that on purpose, aren't you?

zh: 在忙吗？
en: Busy?

zh: 厂里新上了一条线，做电驱的壳体。研发那层楼空着，我给你留着。
en: We've put in a new line at the factory, e-drive housings. The R&D floor is empty. I'm keeping it for you.

zh: ……你自己的事，你自己想清楚。钱够不够？
en: ...Your life, you think it through. Do you have enough money?

zh: 嗯。你妈让你按时吃饭。挂了。
en: Mm. Your mother says eat properly. Bye.

zh: 到上海了？
en: You're in Shanghai?

zh: 住哪儿？
en: Where are you staying?

zh: ……嗯。你妈让我问你吃饭了没有。
en: ...Mm. Your mother wants to know if you've eaten.

zh: 钱的事你自己有数。专利那笔钱，别全扔在车上。有空回南京一趟，厂里的事我们当面谈。
en: You know your own mind about money. Don't throw all the patent money at a car. Come back to Nanjing when you can. We'll talk about the factory in person.

zh: 行。挂了。
en: Fine. I'm hanging up.

zh: 你好，我是知夏的朋友沈既白，想了解一下 Huracán。
en: me

zh: 稍等一下哦，马上好。
en: Just a moment, nearly ready.

zh: 您好～扫码点单哦，码在窗口这边。
en: Hi! Scan the code by the window to order.

zh: 喂，沈既白，听说你那个手套专利的钱到账了？……别装，若安都跟我说了。周末来不来天马，带你跑两圈。还有——真的，你该换台车了，那台二手 Model 3 你还开着呢？
en: Hey, Shen Jibai, heard the money for your glove patent came through? ...Don't play dumb, Ruoan told me. Come to Tianma this weekend, I'll take you round a few laps. And seriously, you need a new car. Are you still driving that second-hand Model 3?

zh: 白白，帮个忙。我想给赛车做个数据记录仪：CAN总线读转速和刹车压力，GPS记圈速，再加个陀螺仪看G值。你会做吧？零件我出，送到你那个创客空间。
en: Baibai, a favour. I want a data logger for my race car: revs and brake pressure off the CAN bus, GPS for lap times, a gyro for the g-forces. You can build that, right? I'll pay for the parts and send them to your makerspace.

zh: 白白，妈妈看到你朋友圈了，那个车……你爸还不知道。你自己注意安全，按时吃饭。
en: Baibai, Mum saw your Moments. That car... your father doesn't know yet. Be careful, and eat properly.

zh: 白白，到上海好几天了，吃得惯吗？有空给你爸打个电话，他嘴上不说，天天问我你怎么样。
en: Baibai, you've been in Shanghai a few days now. Are you eating properly? Call your father when you can. He won't say it, but he asks me about you every day.

zh: 沈先生？我是Vivian。这台是我们的试驾车，Huracán LP610-4，5.2升V10自然吸气，您随便看。
en: Mr Shen? I'm Vivian. This is our demo car, the Huracán LP610-4: 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V10. Have a good look.

zh: （她探身进去按了启动键。V10先是一声吼，然后低低地怠速。路边好几个人回头。）
en: (She leans in and presses start. The V10 barks, then settles into a low idle. Several people on the pavement turn round.)

zh: 车身色我推荐这四个，上海这边绿色的最少见。
en: For the body I would suggest one of these four. Green is the rarest in Shanghai.

zh: 内饰呢？黑色Alcantara比较运动，赤陶棕的皮革在白天特别好看。
en: And inside? Black Alcantara is the sporty one; the terracotta leather looks wonderful in daylight.

zh: 好的！定金收到了。上牌和尾款的事我微信上跟您确认～
en: Wonderful, the deposit's in. I'll confirm the plate and the balance with you on WeChat.

zh: 银行卡余额好像不够……没关系，您方便的时候再说。
en: It looks like there isn't enough in the account... No problem, whenever suits you.

zh: 好的，有问题随时微信我。
en: Of course. Message me any time.

zh: 大家跟紧了啊，别走散了！
en: Stay close, everyone, don't get separated!

zh: 对面就是陆家嘴，那个球就是东方明珠。
en: Across the river is Lujiazui; the one with the spheres is the Oriental Pearl.

zh: 我们在这里拍照十五分钟，然后在这里集合。
en: Fifteen minutes here for photos, then we meet back right here.

zh: 看我的小旗子啊，跟着小旗子走！
en: Watch my little flag, follow the flag!

zh: 身后这一排老房子，一百年前都是银行和洋行。
en: This row of old buildings behind you were all banks and trading houses a hundred years ago.

zh: 注意安全，不要靠在栏杆上。
en: Careful, please, don't lean on the railing.

zh: 最高的那栋是上海中心，六百三十二米。
en: The tallest one is the Shanghai Tower, six hundred and thirty-two metres.

zh: 拍好了吗？我们往南京路走了啊。
en: Got your photos? We're heading on to Nanjing Road.

zh: 车辆进站，请注意安全。
en: Bus arriving, please take care.

zh: 上车请往里走，下车请走后门。
en: Please move inside; please leave by the rear door.

zh: 车辆起步，请站稳扶好。
en: The bus is moving off, please hold on.

zh: 哎，灯暗下来了。
en: Oh, the lights have gone down.

zh: 十点了，外滩的灯要换成夜里的了。
en: Ten o'clock. The Bund's gone over to its night lights.

zh: 还好刚才拍到了。
en: Good thing I got my photo just now.

zh: 各位游客，本班游船即将开航，请抓紧时间登船。
en: Ladies and gentlemen, this sailing leaves shortly. Please come aboard.

zh: 欢迎乘坐浦江游览，本次航程大约半小时，请在甲板上注意安全。
en: Welcome aboard the Huangpu River cruise. We'll be out for about half an hour; please take care on deck.

zh: 左手边是外滩，一百多年前的银行和洋行，被称为万国建筑博览群。
en: On your left, the Bund: banks and trading houses from a century ago, the city's "museum of world architecture".

zh: 右手边就是陆家嘴：东方明珠、金茂大厦、环球金融中心和上海中心。
en: On your right, Lujiazui: the Oriental Pearl, Jin Mao, the World Financial Center and the Shanghai Tower.

zh: 游船现在调头，沿浦东一侧返回。
en: We're turning now, and coming back along the Pudong side.

zh: 再往前就是外滩码头了。
en: The Bund pier is just ahead.

zh: 游船即将靠岸，请带好随身物品，注意脚下。
en: We're coming in to the pier. Please take your belongings and mind your step.

zh: 沈先生是吧？程小姐在里面等您。这套是顶层，三百二十平，整层就这一户。
en: Mr Shen? Ms Cheng's inside. Top floor, three hundred and twenty square metres, the only flat on the floor.

zh: 来了。
en: You came.

zh: 家里想让我在上海有个落脚的地方。他们看中的是这个景。
en: My family want me to have somewhere in Shanghai. It's the view they're buying.

zh: 你是学设计的。除了景，这房子还有什么？
en: You studied design. Apart from the view, what is there to this place?

zh: ……中介没说过这个。
en: ...The agent didn't mention that.

zh: 你还是这样，看东西先看毛病。
en: You haven't changed. You always see the faults first.

zh: 嗯。所有人都这么说。
en: Mm. Everyone says that.

zh: ……没人问过我这个。
en: ...Nobody's asked me that.

zh: 你也不说话。
en: You're not saying anything either.

zh: 那就好。中介说得够多了。
en: Good. The agent talks enough.

zh: 程小姐，业主那边说价格还能谈，一点八个亿是挂牌价。
en: Ms Cheng, the owner says there's room on the price. A hundred and eighty million is only the asking.

zh: 我再想想。
en: I'll think about it.

zh: 你觉得呢？买不买？
en: What do you think? Should I buy it?

zh: ……你回来才几天，就开始管我了。
en: ...You've been back, what, three days, and you're already telling me what to do.

zh: 你跟我爸一个口气。
en: You sound like my father.

zh: 租。程家的人租房子。
en: Rent. A Cheng, renting.

zh: ……也不是不行。
en: ...Not impossible, I suppose.

zh: 好。你不说，我自己定。
en: Fine. If you won't say, I'll decide myself.

zh: 走吧。……我还要跟中介谈，你自己打车。
en: Go on. ...I've still got to talk to the agent. Get yourself a car.

zh: 白白！来来来。这是周学长，我们学校机械系的，现在做协作机械臂。
en: Baibai! Come in. This is Zhou, a senior from our university, mechanical engineering. Cobots now.

zh: 你好你好。明轩说你在旧金山做过硬件。
en: Hi, hi. Mingxuan says you did hardware in San Francisco.

zh: 问题是这样：速度上到每分钟四十次，夹爪就开始掉件。电机、控制都查过了。客户月底要看演示。
en: Here's the thing. Once we're up to forty picks a minute, the gripper starts dropping parts. We've been through the motors and the control loop. The customer wants a demo at the end of the month.

zh: 你看，就是这样。
en: Watch. There it goes.

zh: ……指垫。我们一直在加夹力。
en: ...The pads. We kept turning up the grip force.

zh: 我去拿硅胶的那套！
en: I'll get the silicone set!

zh: 没问题，你随便看。
en: Sure. Take your time.

zh: ……好问题。合同里写的是三十。
en: ...Good question. The contract says thirty.

zh: 四十是我们自己加的……
en: Forty was our own idea...

zh: 他就这样，看东西不说话，说了就准。
en: He's like this. Quiet while he looks, and then he's right.

zh: 怎么样，有没有兴趣？他们缺一个懂产品又懂工程的人。
en: So, interested? They need someone who gets product and engineering both.

zh: 太好了！
en: Brilliant!

zh: 我就知道。
en: Knew it.

zh: 理解，不急。
en: Fair enough. No rush.

zh: 被你看穿了。两件事都想。
en: You've got me. Both, honestly.

zh: 行，你回去想想。资料我发你。
en: OK, think about it. I'll send you the deck.

zh: 晚上一起吃饭？……算了，你先回去倒时差。
en: Dinner tonight? ...Actually no. Go home and sleep off the jet lag.

zh: 来了！今天你也是主角。
en: You made it! You're part of the show today.

zh: 王总，这位就是沈既白，指垫的主意是他出的。
en: Mr Wang, this is Shen Jibai. The pads were his idea.

zh: 三十个件，一个没掉。年轻人，你是做硬件的？
en: Thirty parts, not one dropped. Young man, you do hardware?

zh: 那个专利我看过。有空聊聊，我请。
en: I've read that patent. Let's talk sometime, my treat.

zh: 好的建议值钱。
en: Good suggestions are worth money.

zh: 他太谦虚了。
en: He's being modest.

zh: 话不多，我喜欢。
en: Not a talker. I like that.

zh: 今晚庆功，必须来。
en: Celebration tonight. No excuses.

zh: 要点什么？
en: What can I get you?

zh: 扫这里就好。
en: Just scan here.

zh: 稍等一下，马上就好。
en: Won't be a moment.

zh: 生煎好了！小心烫！
en: Shengjian's up! Careful, they're hot!

zh: 慢走啊！
en: Take care now!

zh: ……你知道这省了我们多少事吗？两周的测绘。下次请你吃饭，我请。
en: ...Do you know how much work that just saved us? Two weeks of measuring. Dinner's on me next time.

zh: 每一格都是手工做的，九十多年了。……要是有台便携的激光雷达就好了，我们量了三个礼拜。
en: Every one of those coffers was made by hand, ninety-odd years ago. ...If only we had a portable LiDAR. We've been measuring for three weeks.

zh: 跟紧我。保安认识我。
en: Stay close. The guard knows me.

zh: ……嗯？几点了……你这椅子比我床还舒服。我就再睡十分钟，十分钟……
en: ...Hm? What time is it... this chair is comfier than my bed. Ten more minutes. Ten...

zh: 白白……谢了。真的。
en: Baibai... thanks. Really.

zh: 来啦。准时，难得。
en: You came. On time, for once.

zh: ……谁啊？我们没叫客房服务。
en: ...Who is it? We didn't order room service.

zh: 先生，先生！请刷卡，没有预约不能进去。
en: Sir! Sir, you need to badge in. No entry without an appointment.

zh: 晚上好，沈先生。
en: Good evening, Mr Shen.

zh: 沈先生，晚上好，欢迎回来。这是您的房卡，612，江景房。
en: Good evening, Mr Shen, welcome back. Here's your key card: 612, a river-view room.

zh: 爵士吧九点半开始，今晚是老年爵士乐队，要帮您留位吗？
en: The Jazz Bar starts at half past nine. The Old Jazz Band tonight. Shall I hold a table for you?

zh: 目前没有您的快递哦。需要叫车的话我帮您约。
en: Nothing waiting for you at the moment. If you need a car, I can book one.

zh: 先生，电梯需要刷房卡，住客才能上去。
en: Sorry, sir, the lifts need a room card. Guests only.

zh: 沈先生，六楼南边在装修，您那间不受影响。
en: Mr Shen. The south end of six is being refitted, sir; your room's not affected.

zh: 先生，那边是员工通道哦。
en: Sir, that's the staff corridor.

zh: 您好，请问您找哪家公司？没有预约的话需要先在小程序上登记，被访人确认后人脸就能过闸机。上个月刚换的新闸机。
en: Hello, which company are you visiting? Without an appointment you register on the mini-program first; once your host confirms, your face opens the gates. They put the new gates in last month.

zh: 下一首……送给我兄弟白白，今天刚从旧金山回来。欢迎回家。
en: This next one... is for my friend Baibai, just back from San Francisco. Welcome home.

zh: 七点开门，先生。乐队八点上台。
en: We open at seven, sir. The band's on at eight.

zh: 先生，微信好像没付成功。
en: Sir, the WeChat payment didn't go through.

zh: 威士忌酸，您慢用。
en: A whisky sour, sir. Enjoy.

zh: 您是 Momo 的朋友吧？前排给您留了位置，舞台边上那张。
en: You must be Momo's friend. We kept you a table at the front, by the stage.

zh: 晚上好，一位吗？这边请。
en: Good evening. Just one? This way, please.

zh: 可以啊小沈，焊点很漂亮。
en: Nice one. Those joints are clean.

zh: 能用就行，下次手再稳一点。
en: It works. Steadier hand next time.

zh: 小沈来啦！你的工作台给你留着，零件在门口那个架子上。
en: Hey, Shen! Your bench is waiting. Parts are on the shelf by the door.

zh: 不好意思……请问，地铁二号线，南京东路站，怎么走？
en: Excuse me, sorry. Line 2, East Nanjing Road station, which way is it?

zh: 我的地图一直在转圈。
en: My map keeps spinning round.

zh: 你好！请问南京路步行街往哪边走？
en: Hi! Which way is the Nanjing Road shopping street?

zh: 太好了，谢谢你！
en: Brilliant, thank you!

zh: 没关系，还是谢谢你。
en: No worries, thanks anyway.

zh: 好的，我跟着你。
en: Great, I'll follow you.

zh: 就是这里！太感谢了，祝你玩得开心！
en: This is it! Thank you so much. Have a lovely evening!

zh: 等等我！
en: Wait for me!

zh: 你好，请问……
en: Hello, excuse me…

zh: 你好！能帮我们拍张照吗？要把东方明珠拍进去！
en: Hi! Could you take a photo of us? With the Pearl in it!

zh: 哇，拍得真好！谢谢你！
en: Oh, that's lovely! Thank you!

zh: 能把东方明珠也拍进去吗？
en: Could you get the Pearl in too?

zh: 诶，我们的头被切掉了……再来一张？
en: Oh, you've cut our heads off. One more?

zh: 可以再近一点吗？
en: Could you come a bit closer?

zh: 没关系，就这样吧，谢谢！
en: That's fine, it'll do. Thanks!

zh: 好吧，没事，谢谢。
en: Oh, okay. Thanks anyway.

zh: 诶？这是我的手机！我还以为丢了！
en: Hey, that's my phone! I thought I'd lost it!

zh: 太谢谢你了。我请你喝杯咖啡吧？
en: Thank you so much. Let me buy you a coffee?

zh: 我转给你了，拿着拿着。
en: There, I've sent it. Go on, take it.

zh: 好人啊，谢谢谢谢！
en: You're a good one. Thanks, really!

zh: 坐。菜我点好了，都是你小时候爱吃的。
en: Sit down. I've ordered. The things you liked as a boy.

zh: 嘉定有个供应商，顺路。
en: A supplier in Jiading. It was on the way.

zh: 嗯。
en: Mm.

zh: 你住在这儿都不嫌贵，我请你吃顿饭你倒嫌贵了。
en: You're staying here, and you worry about the price of dinner?

zh: 你妈说你瘦了。视频里看出来的。
en: Your mother says you've lost weight. She could see it on the video call.

zh: 明轩他爸跟我说了。你们那个机械臂，在投资人面前演示得不错。
en: Mingxuan's father told me. That robot arm of yours did well in front of the investor.

zh: 听说你这几天在陆家嘴、杨浦到处跑。忙什么呢？
en: I hear you've been all over Lujiazui and Yangpu these last few days. Doing what?

zh: 喜欢是一回事，能不能养活人是另一回事。
en: Liking it is one thing. Making a living from it is another.

zh: 瞎忙最累。
en: Busy for nothing is the most tiring kind.

zh: ……哦？说说看。
en: ...Oh? Go on.

zh: 我五十五了。不想再一个人撑着。
en: I'm fifty-five. I don't want to carry it on my own any more.

zh: ……那就做好。别让人看笑话。钱不够，跟我说。
en: ...Then do it properly. Don't let anyone laugh at you. If money's short, tell me.

zh: ……随你。
en: ...Suit yourself.

zh: ……好。你妈会高兴的。
en: ...Good. Your mother will be happy.

zh: ……把方案发给我。下周带他们来厂里看看。
en: ...Send me the proposal. Bring them to the works next week.

zh: 你拿什么让我信？先把你自己的事做成再说。
en: What have you got to make me believe it? Get your own thing working first.

zh: 你还是没想好。没关系。想好了，告诉我。
en: You still haven't decided. That's all right. When you have, tell me.

zh: 吃吧，菜要凉了。
en: Eat. The food's getting cold.
